event.title: FSFE-booth at national NLLGG-meeting in Utrecht, Netherlands

body.p: On December 12th 2026, from about 10.30 to 16 o'clock (local time) we will be available with a FSFE-booth at the national NLLGG meeting, De Schakel, Schoolstraat 11, Vleuten, 3451AA Utrecht, the Netherlands. We are looking forward to have a chat with you about Free Software!
